title: Vintage Cousances by Le Creuset Oval Cocotte – Flame Red / Volcanique – Size 28 – Made in France
description:
Beautiful vintage oval cocotte by Le Creuset under the iconic Cousances line, made in France in enameled cast iron. This classic piece features the highly sought-after flame orange color with cream enamel interior and the original lid marked “Cousances – Le Creuset – France”.
A timeless French kitchen collectible, perfect for slow cooking, roasting, stews, and elegant oven-to-table presentation. The oval shape is especially practical for larger cuts of meat or family meals.
The cocotte is in very good vintage condition overall. The interior enamel remains clean and glossy with light traces of use. The exterior shows minor signs of age and small enamel wear around the rim, consistent with vintage cast iron cookware and adding authentic character.
